description: A grove choked by creeping blight. Clear the hollow and the treant ring, then descend into the Heartwood to face the Hollow Elder. Recommended level 17.

actions.text: Fern Hollow is clear. The Heartwood stirs.
The Treant Ring falls still. The Heartwood stirs.
The Hollow Elder falls. A hoard is revealed.

name: Blightwood Grove
